capabilities: Open a Mermaid toolbar view via ribbon icon or command
Paste Mermaid elements into the editor by clicking them
Create, delete, edit, and reorder toolbar elements in settings
disambiguation: Not a diagram renderer; it only inserts Mermaid source text, since rendering stays Obsidian's own feature.
extras: README notes rendering bugs should be reported to official forums, not the plugin; includes a roadmap with UX improvements planned.
intentEvidence: This plugin adds a toolbar with common Mermaid.js elements, so you won't have to remember them.
motivation: The README implies motivation through the problem statement: so you won't have to remember common Mermaid.js elements.
problem: Obsidian renders Mermaid diagrams natively, but writing them requires memorizing element syntax, and the plugin can't change rendering itself.

relations.evidence: Obsidian supports Mermaid.js natively, via mermaid codeblocks.

summary: Toolbar that pastes common Mermaid.js diagram elements into the editor so you don't have to remember the syntax.
